$comment: C5.7a (DELIVERY_REVIEW.md C11). artifacts/variant_patches.yaml is written by the innovation_expansion stage agent (config_direct_authoring flow; workflow_artifacts/skills/innovation-expansion/SKILL.md IMPROVEMENT 07) or, for a composition run, by code (tools/composition.py::variant_patches_from_manifest via run_phase1_research._composition_variant_patches -> save_yaml). It is checked against this file by stem (tools/workflow_artifact_validation.py) on both the write (save_yaml) and the read (load_yaml, e.g. the backtest_specification tool stage and the variant-shape check) -- warn-only by default, blocking only under WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=raise. What the code enforces at run time is copied here: `variants` non-empty (run_tool_worker backtest_specification); each entry a mapping with a `variant_id` that is a safe bare identifier and unique (5a raises; unique-ness is asserted in tests, JSON Schema cannot state it on a key of an array item); each patch op a mapping with a `path` (a JSON Pointer string starting with '/', tools/json_pointer.py::split_json_pointer) and a `value` key (apply_json_pointer_patch); `kind` one of base/design/asset and `symbol` ONE coin string (tools/variant_coin.py VARIANT_KINDS; a `symbols` key or a list-valued `symbol` is a multi-coin variant that check_variant_shape refuses, G4). Permissive on purpose, each because the code genuinely varies: (1) `patch` may be missing or null -- every reader does `entry.get('patch') or []`; (2) `kind`/`symbol` are optional -- a legacy (coin-less) file is accepted (variant_coin.per_coin_mode) and `symbol` may be omitted on base/design (code fills the base coin), `symbol` may be null (resolve_variant); (3) top-level and entry keys the code never reads are allowed (the LLM adds rationale-like fields; the composition writer adds generated_by / composition_registry_hash instead of base_config_ref); (4) `value` is any JSON value. The per-coin shape rules (exactly one base, >=1 design, 1-2 asset, asset coin from another category, empty patch on base/asset) depend on the run protocol and coin_universe.yaml, so they stay in tools/variant_coin.check_variant_shape, not here.
title: runs/<run>/artifacts/variant_patches.yaml
description: Structured, machine-appliable diffs (JSON-Pointer set operations) against the base config strategy_config_authoring wrote, one entry per variant.

base_config_ref.description: Where the base config this patches against lives (artifacts/backtest_spec.yaml). LLM-written files carry it; the code-written composition file does not.
